sub: PUT, GET, HEAD, LIST, COPY and DELETE.

Overview.p: Basic object operations are PUT (upload), GET (download), HEAD (check), COPY, LIST and DELETE. The CLI wraps them as cp, mv, ls, rm and sync.
Put a file in the locker, get it back, check what is in it, copy it, or throw it away.
A backup script syncs a folder to S3 every night using aws s3 sync.
PUT in • GET out • LIST see • DELETE gone

items: The result is visible immediately (strong consistency)

aws s3api get-object --bucket company-demo-123 --key a.txt out.txt

CLI Commands.p: IDs like i-0abc123 and sg-0abc123 are examples. Replace them with your real IDs.
